notes: Added recovery, expiration handling, and test coverage stories to complete TTL lifecycle.

change_log.value: Stale Lock Detection and Forced Takeover

stories.title: Lock Expiration and Recovery Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to detect expired locks using TTL (expires_at) and allow new acquisition when expired. Ensure expired locks are treated as non-existent without requiring manual cleanup.

stories.title: Stale Lock Detection and Forced Takeover
stories.description: Implement safeguard logic to allow forced lock takeover when a lock is expired but still present due to TTL delay. Must verify expiration timestamp and safely reassign ownership without race conditions.

stories.title: Lock Lifecycle Test Coverage
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering lock acquisition, renewal, expiration, forced takeover, and release. Include race condition scenarios and concurrent acquisition attempts.
